dialog.title: Share record
dialog.description: Give people or teams access to this record beyond what their roles allow. Sharing never allows deleting nor sharing again.
dialog.empty: This record has not been shared yet.
dialog.readOnly: Only the owner of the record or someone allowed to share records can change the shares.

form.teamsUnavailable: You cannot list the teams of the organization.

accessHelp.read: Sees the record in lists, search, reports and exports.
accessHelp.edit: Can also edit, move and archive it when the role allows editing this type.

errors.forbidden: You cannot change the shares of this record.
errors.notFound: The record or the share no longer exists.
errors.exists: The record is already shared with this user or team.
errors.limit: The record reached the share limit.
errors.versionConflict: The share was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.
errors.invalid: Check the chosen grantee and access.
